paite: Huai ban ah unaute aw, tanchinhoih ka hon hilh zaw ka hon theisak nawn ding a; huai tanchinhoih na kipahpih ua, huai mah ah na dingh ua;
heading: Khrist Thohnawnna Makai

paite: k'on thuhilh pen na mawk gintak uh hilou a, pomkip na hih uleh, huai mah ah hotdam in na om uhi.
Amasapen in ke'n ka muh sam nou ka hon hilhsawn a; huchi a, Laisiangthou bangbang a i khelhnate ziak a Khrist asih a,
vui a a-om a, laisiangthou bangbang a ani thum ni a kaihthoh a a-omdan,
huchi a Kifas kiang a akilak a, huai khit a sawm-le-nihte kiang a akilak thute,
huai khit in unau zanga sang a tamzawte kiang ah khatvei thu in akilak nawn a, huaite lak a mi, atamzaw tutan in adam lai ua, khenkhat bel a-ihmuta uhi.
Huai khit in Jakob leh sawltak tengteng kiang ah akilak nawn hi.
Huan atawp pen ah, ahun lou bang a piang, keimah kiang ah leng akilak hi.
Kei zaw sawltak lak a neupen, Pathian saptuamte ka sawi ziak a sawltak chih tuak louh ka hi.

Himahleh Pathian hehpihna ziak in ka hihhih ka hita; huan ahehpihna hon piak athawn in a-om kei a, huchih nak sang in amau tengteng sang in ka semgimzaw hi; himahleh keimah kia in ka sem kei a, Pathian hehpihna ka kiang a om in asem zaw hi.
Himahleh, ke'n leng, amau leng huchi in ka gen zel ua, huchi in nou leng na gingta uhi.
Huan Khrist misi lak a kipan kaihthoh in a-om chih ahon hilh ngal uleh, bangchidan ahia na lak ua khenkhat in, misi thohnawnna himhim a-om kei na chih uh?
heading: Gingtute Thohnawnna

paite: Misi thohnawnna himhim om lou ahihleh, Khrist leng kaihthoh in a-om kei ding hi.
Huan Khrist kaihthoh a a-om keileh, i thugen uh bangmah lou ahi ding a, na gin uh leng bangmah lou ahi ding hi.
Ahi, Khrist akaithou chih Pathian i theihpih ziak in, Pathian lam thu ah theihpih zuauthei i hong hi ding hi, misite kaihthoh a a-om kei uleh, amah leng akaithou kei ding hi.
Misite kaihthoh a a-om kei un zaw, Khrist leng kaihthoh in a-omta kei ding.
Huan Khrist kaihthoh a a-om keileh, na gin uh bangmah lou ahi ding a, na khelhna uah na om nilouh uh ahi ding.
Huchi hileh, Khrist a ihmusate mangthangta uh ahi ding hi.
Tu damsung kia a Khrist tung a lametna i neih in zaw mi tengteng lak a mi hehpihhuaipen i hi ding hi.
Himahleh Khrist misi lak a kipan kaihthoh in a-om taktak ahi, ihmute lak a kipan gah masa ana hita hi.
Mi khat ziak a sihna ahong om ziak in mi khat ziak mah in misi thohnawnna leng ahong omta ahi.
Adam ah mi tengteng asi mah bang un, Khrist ah mi tengteng hihhin in leng a-om ding uhi.
Himahleh amau hun chiat ah; Khrist gah masapente ahi a; huai khit chiang in ahong pai nawn na ah Khrist ate athou ding uhi.
Huai khit chiang in atawp ahong tung ding; huai hun chiang in, vaihawmna tengteng, thuneihna leh thilhihtheihna tengteng ahihman nung in, Pathian kiang ah, Pa kiang ngei ah gam ape ding hi.
Amelmate tengteng akhenuai a akoih masiah ama'n vai hawm ding ahi ngal a.
Melma nanungpen hihmang a om ding sihna ahi.
Ama'n, "Akhenuai ah bangkim akoih hi." Himahleh, "Akhenuai ah bangkim koih in a-om," achih in anuai a bangkim koihpa apang kha kei chih akimu gige ahi.
Huan anuai a bangkim koih a a-om hun chiang in, Tapa mahmah leng anuai ah koih in a-om ding; Pathian bangkim a bangkim ahihtheihna ding in.
Huchi ahih kei in, misite a ding a baptisma atansak uh bang achihna uh hi ding ahia? Misite kaihthoh a om lou ding ahih uleh bang achia amaute a dia baptisma tansak uh ahia?
Bangziak a eite dakkal chih a sih lauhuai a om i hi ua?
Unaute aw, Khrist Jesu i Toupa a ka hon suanna sial in niteng in ka si, ka chi ahi.
Mihing dan in gen leng Ephesa a gamsate kilaipih ka hihleh, kei a ding in bang aphatuam dia? "Misi, kaihthoh a a-om kei ding uleh ne in dawn leng ake, zingchiang a si ding hi ve hang in."
Khem in om kei un, "Lawm giloute'n omdan hoih ahihgawp nak uhi."
Kizentak in halh unla, thil hihkhial kei un; khenkhat in Pathian theihna himhim na nei kei ua. Hiai tuh na zumna ding ua ka gen ahi.
Himahleh kuahiam khat in, "Misi bangchi in kaihthoh ahi ding uh? Pumpi bangchibang pu in ahia ahong thoh ding?" chi ahi ding e.
heading: Thounawn Pumpi

paite: Nang, mihai, nang mahmah in na tuh leng, asih phot keileh hihhin in a-om sam a;
huan chi na tuh in apumpi hong om ding pen ahi kei a, atang lel na tuh zaw nak, buhtang hiam, chi dang tang hiam ahi thei hi.
Himahleh Pathian in ama deih bangbang in pumpi apia a, haichitang chih kiang ah amau pumpi chiat apia hi.
Sa tengteng sa chi khat ahi kei ua; mihing sa atuam a, gamsa sa atuam; vasa sa atuam a, ngasa sa atuam hi.
Van pumpi a-om a, leitung pumpi leng a-om, himahleh van lam pumpite thupina atuam a, lei lam pumpite thupina atuam hi.
Nisa thupina atuam a, khapi thupina atuam a, aksite thupina atuam; aksi leh aksi leng athupina uh atuam ziak in.
Misite thohnawnna leng tua bang ahi. Muat thei a tuh in a-om a, muat thei lou a kaihthoh in a-om hi.
Pahtawi louh a tuh in a-om a, thupitak a kaihthoh in a-om hi. Hat lou a tuh in a-om a, thilhihtheihna nei a kaihthoh in a-om hi.
Pianken pumpi a tuh in a-om a, khalam pumpi a kaihthoh in a-om hi. Pianken pumpi a-omleh khalam pumpi leng a-om hi.
Huchi in mi masapen, "Adam mihing ahong hi a," chi a gelh ahi; Adam nanung pen bel hinna pepa kha ahong hita hi.
Himahleh khalam a-om masa kei a, salam a-om zaw; huai zoh in khalam pen a-om hi.
Mihing masa pen lei a siam, leimi ahi a; mihing nihna pen van a pan ahi.
Lei a siam mihing leimi ahih bang in, van a kipan mi tuh vanmi ahi.
Huan lei a siam mihing batna i put bang in, van a kipan hong paipa batna leng i pu sam ding uhi.
Unaute aw, sa leh sisan in Pathian lalgam aluah thei kei ding a; muat thei in muat theihlouhna aluah sam kei ding chih, ka gen ahi.
Ngai un, thuguk ka hon hilh ding hi! I vek un i ihmu khol kei ding ua, himahleh i vek un pengkul nanungpen agin chiang in, sawt lou kal in,
Mitphiat kal lou in hihlamdan in i om vekta ding; pengkul ging ding ahi ngal a, huchi in misite muat thei lou in kaihthoh in a-om ding ua, eite leng hihlamdan in i omta ding uhi.
Hiai muat thei in muat theihlouhna asilh ding ahi a, hiai sithei in leng sih theihlouhna asilh sam ding ahi.
Huchi a hiai muat thei in muat theihlouhna asilh a, hiai sithei in sih theihlouhna asilh hun chiang in, huai hun ngeingei in, "Zohna in sihna avalh zouta," chih thugelh ahong tung ding hi.
"Aw sihna, na gu koi a-omta ahia? Aw han, na zohna koi a-omta ahia?"
Sihna gu khelhna ahi a; khelhna thilhihtheihna dan ahi.
Himahleh i Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak a zohna hon pepa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
Huaiziak in ka unau deihtakte aw, kiptak in, hihlin vual louh in, Toupa nasep phatuamngaitak a sem gige in om un, na sepgimna uh Toupa ah athawn ngei kei chih na thei uhi.
